Amber Wellness Clinic About us Discover Amber Wellness What is an LPG Slimming Machine? LPG (Lipomassage) slimming machines are innovative devices used primarily for body contouring and cellulite reduction. These machines employ a technique known as mechanical lipomassage, which combines suction and rollers to enhance blood circulation, break down fat cells, and stimulate collagen production. Historical Background 1. Introduction of LPG Technology (1986) Founding : LPG Systems was founded in 1986 by Louis Paul Guitay in France. His aim was to develop a technique that could improve the appearance of the skin and aid in body shaping, particularly focusing on cellulite. Innovation : The original concept revolved around using a machine that combined mechanical movements with suction to stimulate skin and tissue.
